title: Papillomavirus DNA Extraction from Cervical Brushes Using Wizard® Kit
author: Geórgia ackradt Rêgo

steps.title: Collect Endocervical Material
steps.instruction: Collect endocervical material using a cervical brush.

substeps.instruction: Insert speculum into the vaginal canal.
Introduce the brush into the cervical canal.
Rotate the brush 360 degrees by eight turns to the right and eight to the left.
Transfer the brush to a clean collection tube and store at -80 °C.

steps.title: Prepare Lysis Solution
steps.instruction: Prepare a 1.5 ml microcentrifuge tube (free of DNAses, RNAses, and pyrogens) with 600μl of Nuclei Lysis Solution.

steps.title: Homogenize Sample
steps.instruction: Add the endocervical brush to the tube containing Nuclei Lysis Solution and homogenize by rotating the brush in the solution.

steps.title: RNase Treatment
steps.instruction: Remove the brush and treat the sample with RNase Solution.

substeps.instruction: Add 3µl of RNase Solution.
Mix by inverting the tube 5 times.
Incubate for 30 minutes at 37°C.
Cool to room temperature for 5 minutes.

steps.title: Protein Precipitation
steps.instruction: Precipitate proteins from the room temperature sample.

substeps.instruction: Add 200µl of Protein Precipitation Solution.
Vortex vigorously at high speed for 20 seconds.
Chill on ice for 5 minutes.
Centrifuge at room temperature at 14,000 x g for 4 minutes.
Transfer supernatant to a fresh tube containing 600µl of room temperature 99.5% isopropanol.
Mix gently by inversion.
Centrifuge for 1 minute at 14,000 × g at room temperature.

steps.title: DNA Wash
steps.instruction: Wash the DNA pellet with ethanol.

substeps.instruction: Decant the supernatant.
Add 600µl of room temperature 70% ethanol, rinsing the tube walls and homogenizing by inversion.
Centrifuge for 1 minute at 14,000 × g at room temperature.
Aspirate the ethanol.

steps.title: Dry and Rehydrate DNA
steps.instruction: Dry the pellet and rehydrate the extracted DNA.

substeps.instruction: Invert the tube on clean absorbent paper and air-dry the pellet for 15 minutes.
Rehydrate the DNA in 100µl of DNA Rehydration Solution for 1 hour at 65°C, periodically mixing by gently tapping the tube.
